modules.name: Irama
modules.description: Gamelan sequencer (Java and Bali): gong cycles with colotomic triggers, pathet-weighted balungan that mutates per gong, saron/peking/bonang parts at 5 irama levels, kotekan and imbal interlocking pairs, angsel breaks, kebyar bursts, suwuk ending, ombak pairs on every pitch output

modules.name: Gatra
modules.description: Gamelan structure as a house / techno drum sequencer: straight kick, gong cycle on drum roles, LAND moves the gong from the end of the cycle to the downbeat, kotekan hats in two interlocking parts, polymeter cycles, swing, drop and fill

modules.name: Ageng
modules.description: Gamelan gong pair (gong ageng + second gong) and kempul, modal bronze: bloom swell, ombak beating, pitch sag, sub out, hand damping

modules.name: Gangsa
modules.description: Balinese gangsa: polos + sangsih players, every note an umbang + isep pair beating at the ombak rate, kantilan octave doubling, hand damping, bamboo resonator, seeded tuning errors

modules.name: Reyong
modules.description: Bonang / reyong kettle gongs (Java or Bali), boss or rim strikes, byot choked hits, cek cymbal clash, sympathy between kettles, plus kenong and kethuk
